{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Midi length cotton blouse in a soft oat color (#e5d8c8) with a relaxed boxy cut and three-quarter sleeves for sun protection.
High-waisted straight-leg trousers in dark indigo denim (#2f3640) featuring a durable twill weave to resist abrasion from cobblestones.
White leather low-top sneakers with a grippy rubber outsole in an off-white shade (#fdfdf5).
A thin wool-blend cardigan in warm taupe (#bfaea0) worn open at the shoulders for warmth during early morning and late evening temperatures.

This outfit works because it prioritizes comfort and durability for walking nine hours on uneven stone surfaces while staying within the everyday dress code. The high-waisted trousers and sturdy sneakers protect your feet from scratches and fatigue, allowing you to explore the old city with ease. The layered approach with the cardigan and blouse ensures you stay comfortable as temperatures fluctuate throughout the day without looking overdressed for a casual stroll."}
